images.filename: Global Forest Change tree-cover loss year in Pursat, 2001-2024.png
images.caption: Map of annual tree-cover loss year in the Global Forest Change dataset for Pursat. Pixels with tree cover of at least 30% in 2000 and no mapped loss through 2024 are shown in green; pixels with mapped tree-cover loss are coloured by the first detected loss year from 2001 to 2024; land below the 30% tree-cover threshold in 2000 is shown in white; ocean areas are shown in pale blue.
images.alt: Map of annual tree-cover loss year in the Global Forest Change dataset for Pursat. Pixels with tree cover of at least 30% in 2000 and no mapped loss through 2024 are shown in green; pixels with mapped tree-cover loss are coloured by the first detected loss year from 2001 to 2024; land below the 30% tree-cover threshold in 2000 is shown in white; ocean areas are shown in pale blue.

images.filename: Elephants on vertical facing wall copy.jpg
images.caption: Elephants with riders depicted on vertical walls and ceiling panels. Note some rides have possible tools and unique head gear or hairstyles. Upper images are unaltered. Lower images use decorrelation stretch software [DStretch; Jon Harman) do enhance subtle color differences. The results enahnce details and reveal otherwise hidden paintings.
images.alt: Elephants with riders depicted on vertical walls and ceiling panels. Note some rides have possible tools and unique head gear or hairstyles. Upper images are unaltered. Lower images use decorrelation stretch software [DStretch; Jon Harman) do enhance subtle color differences. The results enahnce details and reveal otherwise hidden paintings.

images.caption: Left: animal scene panels enhanced with DStretch software. Note the random placement of mammals. Right: original and DStretch enhanced images of humans holding objects. Some have interpreted this to represent ritual scenes, perhaps dancing with musical instruments.
